 =============================
 W.P.(C.) No. 13432 of 2024
 ==============================
 Dated this the 21st day of August, 2024 
 Judgment 
The petitioner challenges Ext.P11 notice issued by the Panchayat refusing the renewal of the licence to run a prawn peeling shed on account of the alleged water pollution. Thereafter, the petitioner was served with Ext.P12 by the Pollution Control Board on 09.05.2024. The petitioner submits that he complied with the directions in Ext.P12, and a reply has already been sent to the Pollution Control Board. The petitioner had replied to Ext.P12 through Ext.P13 and also applied for consent to operate through Ext.P15.
2. Accordingly, there will be a direction to the Pollution Control Board to take a decision on Ext.P15 application for consent to operate. It shall be done within six weeks from today based on the orders to be passed by the Pollution Control Board on the above application preferred by the WP(C) NO.
13432 OF 2024 2024:KER:63829 petitioner and make a fresh application for renewal of licence Salim Marshal vs Chellanam Grama Panchayat on 21 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127801091/
2 before the Panchayat, which shall be considered in accordance with law without any further delay. 
The writ petition is disposed of as above. 
Sd/-
